 2027 AFCON Q: Somalia Captain Abdullahi AbdulSamed Emphasises Hard Work Ahead of Ghana Clash
 📅 November 16, 2026 
  • 
 👤 King 
  • 
 📁 AFCON 
  • 
 🕑 2 min read 
 Somalia captain Abdullahi AbdulSamed has stressed the importance of hard work and discipline as his side prepares to face Ghana, insisting that the team will not use pitch conditions as an excuse for their performance.
 AbdulSamed acknowledged the quality and experience within the Black Stars squad, noting that his players have previously watched Ghana’s key players on television but now have the opportunity to face them on the pitch.
 “It’s all about the effort we put in, and there is no excuse about the pitch conditions or anything like that,” the Somalia skipper said.
 He also admitted that Ghana’s experienced players understand their roles and responsibilities on the field, but revealed that the Somali team has held tactical meetings to determine the best approach to the encounter.
 “The big players here in the Ghana National team, they have experienced quality. They know where to stand and what to do. We have watched them on TV, and now we have experienced them up close. But we have had meetings to discuss how to approach the game,” he added.
 The comments underline Somalia’s determination to approach the challenge with commitment and a clear game plan as they prepare for a difficult test against the Black Stars.
